component.$description: Component decisions that have no semantic equivalent and must match on more than one platform. Everything else a component needs, it takes from the semantic tokens directly.

width.$description: Sidebar widths: expanded, collapsed to icons, and the mobile sheet.

offset.$description: Distance between a tour card and its target.

spotlight-padding.$description: Space the spotlight leaves around its target.

marker-size.$description: Timeline event markers: a 28px square around a 16px icon (size.icon.sm). In px like the icon sizes, so the marker and its icon keep their proportions when the root font size changes.
